pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions are irregularly polygonal with sharp, jagged edge gradients. The pixel-level geometry shows high angularity at vertex points, particularly on the flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored pathways form a continuous topological network with narrow, relatively uniform pixel thickness. Junction nodes consist of multi-point intersections separating the dark polygonal patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette against the light background.

other_distinctive_markers: A small avian-shaped organism is perched on the upper dorsal ridge at the base of the neck, creating a distinct localized silhouette break.
